## What does this Pull Request do?

- [ ] Adds a new unique AI model / AI tool to `README.md`
- [ ] Updates pricing, free plan details, or features for an existing AI
- [ ] Fixes a broken link, typo, or formatting issue

## Checklist

- [ ] **Zero duplicates:** Verified this AI name and official URL do not already appear anywhere in `README.md`
- [ ] **Official direct HTTPS link:** Zero affiliate, shortener, or referral tracking parameters
- [ ] **7-column schema:** Placed in the single best-matching category (`AI Name | Creator | What It Does & Key Features | Best For | Free Plan | Pricing | Platforms`)
- [ ] **Synced statistics:** Updated counts in the top summary badge, `Directory Statistics`, and `Index` table (if adding/removing rows)
- [ ] **Passed CI locally:** Ran `python3 scripts/validate_list.py` with zero errors
